description: Eight rows that each add or subtract a fixed voltage or an attenuverted CV, summing downwards into the row outputs

params.text: Chooses what that row does with its voltage: subtract it from the running total, ignore it, or add it
Sets the voltage that row contributes, -10V to +10V; with that row's CV jack patched it attenuverts the CV instead
Limits which positions that row's -0+ switch can take, to subtract or off, to all three, or to off or add

inputs.text: A voltage for that row to add to or subtract from the running total, scaled by that row's VLT/ATNV knob

outputs.text: The running total down to that row, clamped to ±10V; with 'Stop Adding on Out Cable' ticked the total restarts from 0V at the next row

menu: Stop Adding on Out Cable — resets the running total to 0V after a row whose output has a cable in it, rather than carrying it on down
Attenuator knobs — makes the VLT/ATNV knobs attenuate rather than attenuvert a patched CV, so fully anticlockwise passes none of it and fully clockwise passes all of it
Volt Knob Default: 0V, +1V, +10V — sets the value a VLT/ATNV knob returns to when it is reset
Reset All Knobs to Default — sets every VLT/ATNV knob to the value chosen under Volt Knob Default
